actions.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources Subcommittee on National Parks. Hearings held.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Affects residents, local governments, businesses, and visitors within the designated Calumet region covering three Indiana counties and portions of two Illinois counties.
dimensions.evidence: the Calumet region is composed of-- (A) 3 counties in the State of Indiana; and (B) portions of 2 counties in the State of Illinois

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a federal heritage area designation and management plan framework without imposing regulatory restrictions or mandates on private property.
dimensions.evidence: There is established as a component of the National Heritage Area System the Calumet National Heritage Area

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes federal assistance for the heritage area through the Secretary of the Interior for a limited period, though specific funding sums are not stated.
dimensions.evidence: the authority of the Secretary of the Interior to provide assistance under that section for the Calumet National Heritage Area designated under the amendment made by subsection (a) shall terminate on the date that is 15 years after the date of enactment of this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the John D. Dingell, Jr. Conservation, Management, and Recreation Act to add a single new national heritage area component.

dimensions.assessment: Designation is permanent, but federal financial assistance authority terminates 15 years after enactment, with a management plan due within 3 years.
dimensions.evidence: the authority of the Secretary of the Interior to provide assistance under that section for the Calumet National Heritage Area designated under the amendment made by subsection (a) shall terminate on the date that is 15 years after the date of enactment of this Act.

importance_detail.rationale: Designates the Calumet National Heritage Area in Indiana and Illinois as a component of the National Heritage Area System and names the Calumet Heritage Partnership as the local coordinating entity.
